investigation.title: Swarm Gateway 502 Blocks All Remote Agent Checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime)
investigation.summary: All three remote-agents feature checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed at 2026-09-29T12:40–12:41Z with an identical 502 bad_gateway error: the production-api layer could not reach the swarm backend ELB at /v1/agents. Because the failure occurred before any agent was provisioned, zero required evidence fields (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) were collected, and all contract assertions remain unverifiable.
investigation.rootCause: The swarm provisioning gateway (an AWS ELB in us-east-2 fronting /v1/agents) was unreachable from the production-api at the time of the eval run. Every POST /api/agents request was rejected with HTTP 502 and error code bad_gateway before agent creation could begin, causing all three remote-agents checks to fail with the same message and produce no evidence. This is an eval-observed infrastructure connectivity failure localized to the swarm gateway endpoint; no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence, so impact beyond the observability eval is unconfirmed.
